Proposition
[Variation of the divergence of a one-form] 1. ch2:3.10 Source: topping:page-0033, topping:page-0038 \group topping-background

For a time-dependent $1$-form $\omega $, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\delta \omega =\delta \frac{\partial \omega }{\partial t}+\langle h,\nabla \omega \rangle -\langle \delta G(h),\omega \rangle . \]
